manifest.scope: Six-key finalizer qualification and five-key reference controls; all timings require fresh CPU-audited runs.

summary.timing_boundary: Worker fixture copy, fresh recursive proving and independent CPU root audit; wallet proving, registration and durable host application excluded.

manifest.scope: Five alternating count-four reference/finalizer pairs, fresh roots, identical public leaves and checked equal CPU/GPU/RAM/spill assignments. Proving binaries use the earlier frozen working-tree source archive.

limitations: Only count four on the laptop GPU is compared.
Worker timings include fixture copy, fresh proving and independent CPU audit, and exclude registration, wallet proving and durable host application.
The constructions have distinct registry identities; their root digests need not match.
The same 64 public leaf proofs and body are reused. This is a development milestone, not measured delivered transaction throughput.
Full64 still requires 127 recursive proofs. Compact admission, other mixed counts, both-device qualification and durable application remain separate gates.

summary.scope: Rejection tests on an existing real root; no fresh proving or delivered-throughput measurement.

scope: Five alternating matched reference/finalizer count-four recursive aggregation pairs. Three public user inputs and one issuance per root; no wallet proving or durable host application.
